confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors (meal, midrange, coffee, beer) are triangulated from several cost-of-living aggregators and Jamaica price guides, with a tourist-area uplift applied because sources say Negril prices run above Kingston and rural averages. Sources disagree, so these are bounded estimates. Cocktail and wine are weak: no Negril drink prices were found, so both are set from the local beer relationship (roughly 2.5x and 2.3x the beer anchor). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and comparable Caribbean beach towns. No accommodation searches or live listings were checked. FX: the 0.6955 USD per AUD figure (RBA 4pm rate, 15 October 2026) comes from the RBA exchange-rates overview page as summarised in search results. I did not open the RBA F11 table to confirm it, and I did not use a third-party 16 October figure because it could not be verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Negril is a Caribbean resort town. This taxonomy places the Caribbean under Latin America. Food and drink anchors use aggregated Jamaica and Negril cost-of-living figures (CityCost, Combien Coûte, Travel Cost Calculator, Jamaica price guides), adjusted upward for tourist-area pricing. Cocktail and wine anchors are derived from the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates benchmarked against comparable Caribbean beach-resort towns.
